backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47593

#### PR description:

Following a request in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52304 this PR backports #47593 into 15_0_X (following the policy of requiring backports to be included in all the intermediate release cycles). https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47960 was already backported to 15_0_X in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47973 so it is not included here.

#### PR validation:

None
